title: 花果山请师兄
subtitle: 真心求助，不用故意说反话
origin: 《西游记》第三十至三十一回（低龄温和改编）

moral.zh: 需要伙伴帮忙时，把事实、感受和请求说清楚，比激将、夸张或责怪更有力量。
moral.en: When we need help, clear facts, honest feelings, and a direct request are stronger than teasing, exaggeration, or blame.

pages.zh: 宝象国遇到难题，八戒奉师父之托，回花果山请悟空帮忙。
pages.en: When Baoxiang Kingdom faced trouble, Bajie returned to the Mountain of Flowers and Fruit to ask Wukong for help.
pages.prompt: Zhu Bajie in dark teal tunic approaches sunny Water Curtain Cave where Wukong, wearing narrow golden headband and holding red-and-gold staff upright, shares peaches with friendly monkeys; peaceful reunion, no text.

pages.zh: 八戒怕悟空不答应，刚想说几句故意惹他生气的话，却看见猴群都安静下来。
pages.en: Afraid Wukong might refuse, Bajie almost tried to make him angry, but noticed the monkey troop had gone quiet.
pages.prompt: Bajie hesitates mid-sentence with an awkward expression while Wukong and smaller gray-brown monkeys listen quietly in the bright cave courtyard; no anger, no text.

pages.zh: 一只小猴问：“明明是来求助，为什么不直接说呢？”八戒的脸红了。
pages.en: A little monkey asked, “If you came for help, why not say it directly?” Bajie's cheeks turned pink.
pages.prompt: A small cream-faced monkey gently gestures with open paws toward Bajie, whose rosy cheeks deepen with embarrassment; Wukong listens kindly, no mocking or text.

pages.zh: 八戒重新开口：“师父很担心，公主也在等消息。我一个人想不出办法，想请你一起去。”
pages.en: Bajie began again. “Master is worried, and the princess awaits news. I cannot solve this alone. Will you come with me?”
pages.prompt: Bajie makes a sincere direct request with open empty hands; Wukong sits at equal level and listens closely, monkey troop supportive, no text.

pages.zh: 悟空没有立刻回答，而是问清地点、线索和大家已经试过的方法。
pages.en: Wukong did not answer at once. He asked about the place, the clues, and what the others had already tried.
pages.prompt: Wukong and Bajie arrange picture tokens of palace, flower, moon and road on a stone table to review facts; red-and-gold staff rests upright safely, no text.

pages.zh: 八戒一项项说明，还承认自己一路上很着急。悟空听完说：“这次你把话说清楚了。”
pages.en: Bajie explained each point and admitted he had been anxious. Wukong said, “This time you made the request clear.”
pages.prompt: Warm close conversation between Wukong and Bajie, both relaxed after honest communication; picture tokens neatly arranged, friendly monkeys bring travel bags, no text.

pages.zh: 猴群帮悟空收好果篮和水壶。悟空答应同行，也请八戒以后别再用气话当请帖。
pages.en: The monkeys packed fruit and water. Wukong agreed to go, asking Bajie not to use angry words as invitations again.
pages.prompt: Friendly monkeys pack a woven fruit basket and water flask while Wukong and Bajie seal their agreement with a cheerful palm-to-palm gesture; no text.

pages.zh: 两位师兄弟并肩踏上云路。八戒发现，真心说一句“请帮帮我”，一点也不丢脸。
pages.en: The two brothers set out side by side. Bajie learned that saying “Please help me” honestly was nothing to be ashamed of.
pages.prompt: Wukong rides a low golden cloud beside Bajie on a broad safe mountain path toward distant Baoxiang city, both smiling with restored teamwork; no text.
